docs.title: Welcome to Constellation
docs.text: Constellation is Jack Gledhill's homelab environment. The project's main goals are to provide an environment for learning about, and experimenting with, enterprise-level networking, software and software practices. To that end, it also hosts numerous open-source services to solve everyday problems.

docs.title: Purpose of this Website
docs.text: There came a point during development where managing knowledge about the project became difficult to do without a platform to document it. This website exists primarily to document the specifics around how software is configured and how the individual components interact with one another within the project. As a secondary benefit, this website serves as a record of Jack's work and the knowledge gained from it.

docs.title: Project Repository
docs.text:
Almost everything that went into this project is open-source on GitHub at Jack-Gledhill/constellation. In the repository, you'll find:

  • The source for this website
  • Diagrams explaining the project's internals
  • Bash scripts for managing Proxmox LXCs and VMs1
  • Ansible Playbooks and Roles for automating arduous tasks
  • ArgoCD resources and Kubernetes manifests
  • Docker Compose stacks automatically deployed via GitOps

docs.title: VPN
docs.text: The VPN allows devices to remotely connect to the internal network. This is primarily used for accessing management interfaces, or services that cannot be safely exposed to the internet (e.g. SMB servers).

docs.title: Databases
docs.text: Database servers like PostgreSQL, Redis and MongoDB are managed within an LXC on Sagittarius, aptly named databases. Only one centralised instance of each database server exists, this is to make management and security simpler.

docs.title: Management
docs.text:
pgAdmin 4 has been installed on the database container and configured with credentials for the PostgreSQL server. It can be used to manage databases and users.

Login to pgAdmin

docs.title: Backups & Data Integrity
docs.text:
The database LXC is backed up to Scorpio hourly and retained for up to a week. Backups are encrypted and their integrity is verified regularly. Thanks to this, native database server backup solutions are not needed.

All the data is kept on Sagittarius' ZFS array when hot. Many database servers use small page sizes so they can take advantage of the SSD-backed SPECIAL vDev, improving query times.

  1. Includes pgvector extension ↩
